notes.title: Bounce Ball Blitz is Going Free to Play!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I’ve decided to make Bounce Ball Blitz free to play! Starting September 20, you’ll be able to download and enjoy the game for free. The goal is to make the game accessible to more players, and I believe this change will help grow the community.

Thanks for your support, and I hope to see more of you bouncing around soon!

Andrew Bespaly
